                        ( p. 1109 ) H ميوا मेवा mewā , s.m. corr. of ميوه mewa , q.v. 2) ميواتي mewātī, miwātī
                        ( p. 1109 ) H ميواتي मेवाती mewātī , or miwātī [ mewāt + ī = S. ईयः ], adj. & s.m. Of or belonging to the province of Mewāt; — the robber-tribe of Mewāt (i.q. mew ); a man of that tribe; — a native, or an inhabitant, of Mewāt. 3) ميوجات mewajāt
                        ( p. 1109 ) P ميوجات mewajāt ( mewa +A. pl. suff. āt , with euphon. change of silent h of ميوه into j ), s.m. pl. (of mewa ), Fruits. 4) ميوه mewa, mīwa
                        ( p. 1109 ) P ميوه mewa , or mīwa (old P. and Pehl. mīwa ), s.m. Fruit: — mewa-dār , vulg. mewe-dār , adj. Fruit-bearing, fruitful; laden with fruit: — mewa-farosh , s.m. Fruit-seller, fruiterer: — tar mewa , Fresh fruit: — ḵẖushk mewa , Dried fruit. Search Form • DDSA Close

A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'महीना' 2 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) مہينا mahīnā
                        ( p. 1103 ) P H مہينا महीना mahīnā [ mah = māh , q.v.+ īna = Zend aêna = S. इन् ], s.m. A month; — monthly pay or wages, salary: — mahīnā-bhar , The whole month: — mahīnā ćaṛhnā , v.n. To be in arrears; — the time for menstruation to pass: — mahīnā-dār , vulg. mahīn-dār , s.m. A monthly servant: — mahīne-se honā , v.n. To be in a state of menstruation (i.q. kapṛon-se honā ): — mahīnā-wār , or mahīna-wār , or mahīne-wār , adj. Of or pertaining to a month; monthly, every month: — mahīnā-wārī , or mahīna-wārī , s.f. Monthly wages, salary, stipend: — mahīne-ke mahīne , or (dialec.) mahīne-gail , adj. = mahīnā-wār : — mahīne-kī hāṅḍī , s.f. Monthly obsequies. 2) مہيناري mahīnārī
                        ( p. 1103 ) H مہيناري महीनारी mahīnārī [ mahīnā , q.v. + Prk. आलिआ = S. आल + इका ], s.f. The menses (i.q. mahīne-kī bīmārī ). Search Form • DDSA Close

A descriptive roll: — ćěhra-shāhī , adj. Having or bearing the king's (or queen's) head (coin): — ćěhre-kī lenā (- ke ), To make faces, to mock: — ćěhra likhānā (- kā ), To have (a person's) descriptive roll made out, to enroll, to enlist; — to take service and horses: — ćěhra likhnā (- kā ), To take down a description (of a person), to make a descriptive roll (of), to enroll, to register: — ćěhra-mohrā , s.m.                         ( p. 925 ) P گوشت gosht [Pehl. gosht ; Zend geus , gen. of gāo + tanu ; S. gos , gen. of go + tanu ], s.m.
